title: Quaint Yeasty Slovakian Buckwheat Pilaf
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring buckwheat, bhuna, and a yeasty flavor, served in a copper mug. This satvik-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine yeast and 1 cup of warm water, stirring to dissolve.
Let the yeast mixture sit for 5 minutes, until it becomes frothy.
In a large copper mug, heat ghee over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add buckwheat, bhuna spice mix, salt, and yeast mixture to the copper mug, stirring to combine.
Add remaining 1 cup of water to the mug and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover the mug, and simmer for 15 minutes, until the buckwheat is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in chopped parsley.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
